name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 8 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-11-13, at wavelengths from 0.87 to 4.64 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
